description: A React component for displaying and managing a table of jobs in the Mattermost admin console, including pagination, job actions, and rendering job details.

classes.name: JobTable
classes.description: A React component class for rendering a paginated table of jobs with controls for actions like canceling and creating jobs.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches jobs of the specified type and sets up periodic reload.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Clears the reload interval when component unmounts.

methods.name: getExtraInfoText
methods.description: Returns extra info text for a job, including error messages if present.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the list of jobs by calling getJobsByType.

methods.name: handleCancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job by ID and reloads the job list.

methods.name: handleCreateJob
methods.description: Creates a new job of the specified type and reloads the list.

methods.name: handleNextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page in pagination if available.

methods.name: handlePrevPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page in pagination if possible.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the job table with pagination, action buttons, and job details.
